intro: Denmark gave the world Hans Christian Andersen's fairy tales, LEGO, sleek modern design and the New Nordic food movement.

chapters.title: Fairy tales and design
text: Hans Christian Andersen wrote The Little Mermaid, The Ugly Duckling and The Snow Queen, which inspired Frozen. A statue of the Little Mermaid has sat in Copenhagen harbour since 1913.
Danish designers created famous chairs, lamps and speakers, and the architect Jørn Utzon designed the Sydney Opera House.

chapters.title: Food and fun
text: Smørrebrød, open sandwiches on dark rye bread, are a lunchtime classic, and Copenhagen restaurant Noma helped launch 'New Nordic' cooking. Copenhagen's Tivoli Gardens, opened in 1843, is one of the oldest amusement parks in the world.
